alt: 父親正耐心勸說桌前的男孩，男孩卻用雙手摀住耳朵、把臉轉向一旁，不肯聽取意見。
scene_prompt: 充耳不聞 means deliberately refusing to listen to another person's advice. Contemporary family dining room. A stubborn older boy sits at the table with BOTH hands pressed gently over his ears, his eyes turned away and lips pursed in obvious deliberate refusal. A caring father sits beside him speaking calmly and gesturing toward the boy's scattered school worksheets and a simple game controller left on the table. Father clearly tries to advise him about balancing work and play; boy knowingly shuts the advice out. No headphones, hearing aids or imagery suggesting actual hearing loss. Two humans only, exactly two arms and two legs each; boy's two palms touch corresponding ears with plausible elbows and shoulders; father's hand gestures clear. Worksheets may contain faint unrecognizable pencil writing texture but no readable words, letters, numbers or answers. Calm concerned father not shouting or threatening, child-safe domestic scene, no scolding violence. Strong mobile-readable focus on refusal to listen rather than noise annoyance.
